title: Existing consumed REST callbacks (OnBeforeRequest, OnAfterResponse) read and edited as keyed flow text

capabilities.title: Read and edit the existing callbacks of a consumed REST client (OnBeforeRequest, OnAfterResponse) as keyed flow text
capabilities.summary: ssam_map view flow, element <Client>.OnBeforeRequest or <Client>.OnAfterResponse, reads the callback as callback action <Client>.<Name> @key with its textSha. Edit that text and send it in a logic op: {"op":"logic","data":{"flow":<text>,"basedOn":<textSha>}}. Only what changed is written; the callback's native inputs and outputs (Request, Response, CustomizedRequest, CustomizedResponse) stay the platform's.

route.operation: studio_deliver / o11_deliver op logic, data.flow: callback action <Client>.OnBeforeRequest|OnAfterResponse @key, with basedOn

capabilities.guidance: Read the callback first and keep its @key, its name and its owner. Keep the request/response passthrough and the existing exception behavior. Never declare in/out lines (FLOW_CALLBACK_PARAMETERS) nor rename the callback (FLOW_CALLBACK_NAME); locals are allowed. A header without @key is refused (FLOW_CALLBACK_CREATION names the callback's @key; FLOW_CALLBACK_UNKNOWN names the nearest callbacks): create the callbacks with the rest-consume op (callbacks.before/after). On ODC, OnAfterResponse receives Response, not the original Request: per-call correlation belongs to the action that calls the method.

limits.text: Existing consumed callbacks only; read, keyed edit, save and read-back offline in RestCallbackFlowScenarios. A live delivery is still to be proven.
The Advanced callbacks and the exposed REST OnRequest/OnResponse are not proven by this route.
